extcost-m-define-annotated.comment: Lowered from 75241 on 2026-08-16, -27000 over 3000 calls, which is nine inferences per call. A literal argument's type is settled while the call site compiles, so translate_args_by_type_dl/7 emits no has_type/2 check for one; a call whose arguments are all literals of the declared types now compiles to exactly what the untyped one does, with no once/1 wrapper either. The published table's annotated row moved 20.00 -> 11.00 inferences per call and 6.67x -> 3.67x against an ordinary MeTTa function. The drop is one-directional and never rejects: a literal of the WRONG declared type keeps its check and is still refused, because a get-type extension may give a literal a second type and deciding that statically would be unsound. Guarded by translator_literal_type_checks in tests/prolog/suites/translator/translator.plt.
